score_method: Unweighted average of the six audit weighted-pass scores. not_checked_blocked and not_applicable rows are excluded from each audit denominator.

audits.coverage_warning: Only two rows were evaluable; this is not a complete technical pass.

top_fixes.finding: Mobile field LCP is 3.662s and field TTFB is 1.745s; mobile Lighthouse performance is 45.
top_fixes.fix: Optimize origin/caching and the true LCP element, then rerun PageSpeed and CrUX after deployment.
top_fixes.impact: Faster landing pages and stronger page-experience performance.

top_fixes.finding: Homepage Organization/WebSite markup is incomplete: sameAs is absent, the logo is not a verified logo asset, and WebSite description is empty.
top_fixes.fix: Correct canonical entity markup and validate each template with Schema.org Validator and Google Rich Results Test.
top_fixes.impact: Clearer entity understanding and safer rich-result eligibility.

top_fixes.finding: The heading hierarchy starts at H2/H3 and uses 'Fresh Milk Collection' as the only H1.
top_fixes.fix: Make the page's main value proposition the H1 and nest all sections/cards logically.
top_fixes.impact: Improved semantic clarity for users, assistive technology, and search engines.

top_fixes.finding: 64 of 94 homepage images lack useful alt coverage, and the mobile Lighthouse accessibility score is 79.
top_fixes.fix: Classify decorative versus meaningful images, add correct alt behavior, remove zoom-blocking viewport settings, and run a full accessibility audit.

top_fixes.finding: The Shudh Ghee page's meta description describes Dahi.
top_fixes.fix: Correct the description and crawl all indexable pages for mismatched or duplicate metadata.
top_fixes.impact: More accurate snippets and stronger page-topic alignment.

top_fixes.finding: Nutrition Centre content has no visible author or source signals in the sampled render.
top_fixes.fix: Add author/reviewer identity, relevant credentials, source citations, and editorial policy links.
top_fixes.impact: Stronger trust and E-E-A-T signals for food and nutrition-adjacent content.

top_fixes.finding: llms.txt returns 404 and AI-answer visibility was not benchmarked.
top_fixes.fix: Approve an AI-crawler policy, publish a maintained llms.txt if appropriate, and define repeatable priority-prompt monitoring.
top_fixes.impact: Clearer machine access policy and measurable AI visibility.
